instruction: Create a mount unit for a data partition
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/mnt-data.mount <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Data partition

[Mount]
What=/dev/sdb1
Where=/mnt/data
Type=ext4
Options=defaults

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
EOF

instruction: Create an automount unit for lazy mounting
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/mnt-data.automount <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Automount data partition

[Automount]
Where=/mnt/data

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
EOF

Create a mount unit for a tmpfs in-memory filesystem
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/run-myapp.mount <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=MyApp runtime tmpfs

[Mount]
What=tmpfs
Where=/run/myapp
Type=tmpfs
Options=mode=0755,size=64M

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
EOF

Create a custom target that groups related services
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/myapp.target <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=My Application Stack
Requires=postgresql.service myapp-web.service
Wants=myapp-worker.service
After=postgresql.service myapp-web.service
EOF

Create a mount unit with network dependency
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/mnt-nfs.mount <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=NFS mount
Requires=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Mount]
What=192.168.1.100:/exports/data
Where=/mnt/nfs
Type=nfs
Options=defaults

[Install]
WantedBy=remote-fs.target
EOF

instruction: Create a mount unit for a CIFS/Samba share
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/mnt-share.mount <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Samba share

[Mount]
What=//192.168.1.100/share
Where=/mnt/share
Type=cifs
Options=credentials=/etc/smbcreds,uid=1000,gid=1000

[Install]
WantedBy=remote-fs.target
EOF

instruction: Create a systemd target for maintenance mode
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/maintenance.target <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Maintenance Mode
Requires=multi-user.target
Conflicts=rescue.target
AllowIsolate=yes
EOF
